functional_semantics.triton: Y[off] = X[off] * S[(off // N) // TILE_SIZE, (off % N) // TILE_SIZE] over the flat M*N index space, S row stride cdiv(N, TILE_SIZE), fresh (M, N) output (impl_triton.py 14-28, 45-46).
functional_semantics.cutile: out[off] = X_flat[off] * gather(S, ((off // N) // TILE_SIZE, (off % N) // TILE_SIZE)) over the flat M*N index space, fresh (M, N) output (impl_cutile.py 24-41, 49-52).
functional_semantics.note: Both realise X * S[row_idx[:, None], col_idx[None, :]] with floor-division block indexing (impl_torch.py 5-8) without materialising the expanded scale map.

stages.triton: One kernel, one launch, grid = ceil(M*N/block) (50, 54).
stages.note: Identical single-stage flat elementwise map with a per-element scale gather.

precision.triton: No upcast; a single native-dtype multiply (26).
precision.cutile: No upcast; a single native-dtype multiply (39).
precision.note: Native-dtype multiply on both sides, identical to the reference.

preprocessing.triton: torch.empty(M, N); S_COLS = cdiv(N, TILE_SIZE); total = M*N; M/N/S_COLS/TILE_SIZE passed as constexpr (45-47, 51, 55-57).
preprocessing.cutile: torch.empty(M, N); X.contiguous().view(-1), output.view(-1); total = M*N; N/TILE_SIZE passed as ConstInt (49-52, 75).
preprocessing.note: Output allocation, views and host integer arithmetic only, inside run() on both sides; no copy, cast, expanded scale map or cached state.

intermediate_storage.triton: None (whole file); the reference's (M, N) scale map is not materialised.
intermediate_storage.cutile: None (whole file); the reference's (M, N) scale map is not materialised.

mutation.triton: X, S read-only; fresh output each call (45).
mutation.cutile: X, S read-only; fresh output each call (49); tuning launches overwrite out_flat (61), rewritten by the final launch.
mutation.note: No input mutation; idempotent; the contract forbids mutation.

hardware_dispatch.note: Single code path on both sides. Tail handling (Triton mask 15-28 vs cuTile ZERO padding and padding_value=0 gather 28, 37) is a legality detail.

fq_boundary.bytes_expr: 2 * M * M * dtype_size + ((M + TILE_SIZE - 1) // TILE_SIZE) ** 2 * dtype_size
fq_boundary.note: Both timed run() bodies allocate the output and launch one kernel that reads X once, writes Y once and gathers one scale per element (the formula counts S once, i.e. assumes the repeated per-element scale requests are cache-served); no clone, zero-fill, scratch or cached prepack on either side. The expressions hard-code the square case N == M (config.yaml 17-18), which the generator guarantees (tensors.py 493-494: N defaults to M, only M is swept) although run() accepts a distinct N.

review_items: bytes_expr and flops_expr hard-code N == M (M*M terms) while run() and the generator accept a distinct N; decide whether to generalise the expressions to M*N (no measured case is affected). Non-blocking for the contract text.
